checks.name: logo_rule_pal
checks._comment: Solid white rule at band row 13 (raster lines 155-162). matCell(k,13*40+c) returns code 0 (font all-$FF) for every column; colour RAM white at those positions. This reads a known matrix cell value (code 0) through the custom font: if either the matrix content or font is wrong, white pixels are absent. Phase-independent width: the wobble shifts each band line by 0 to 55 pixels (the sine is capped at 55, k_max 6), so the cells of the 40-column rule that are white at every phase run from vic_x 24 + 55 to 343 - 55, and this rect covers 112 to 287 of them. Until 2026-09-23 it was 220 wide (to 331), written for the phase at the 10,000,000-cycle shot of an earlier part 1; when part 1's PAL/NTSC detection was put under SEI the prepare took a different number of frames, the phase at the shot moved, and the rule's right end fell 41 pixels short of 331 on PAL.

checks._comment: Same rule on NTSC, the same phase-independent width.
